q1.explanationZh: tube 名词“管子；软管”，英国口语里也指伦敦地铁。

q2.explanationZh: tuition“学费”，注意拼写 tu-i-tion，-tion 结尾是名词。

q3.explanationZh: tune 名词“曲子；曲调”，sing a tune“唱一首曲子”。

q5.explanationZh: turkey“火鸡”，首字母大写的 Turkey 是国名“土耳其”。

q6.explanationZh: turn 作名词“转动；（轮流的）一次机会”，作动词“转动；转向；变成”，It’s your turn.“轮到你了。”

q7.explanationZh: tutor 作名词“家庭教师；导师”，作动词“辅导”，结尾是 -or。

q8.explanationZh: twice 副词“两次；两倍”，twice a month“每月两次”。

q9.explanationZh: twin“双胞胎之一”，a twin brother“孪生兄弟”，twins 指一对双胞胎。

q10.explanationZh: twist 动词、名词同形，“转动；旋转”，give sth. a twist“把……转一下”。

q11.explanationZh: type 作名词“类型”，作动词“打字”，different types of“各种各样的”。

q12.explanationZh: typhoon“台风”，注意拼写 ty-phoon：ph 读 /f/，oo 双写。

q13.explanationZh: type 的形容词 typical“典型的”，be typical of“是……的典型特点”。

q14.explanationZh: type 去 e 加 -ist 表示人，typist“打字员”。

q15.explanationZh: tyre“轮胎”是英式拼写，美式拼写是 tire。

q16.explanationZh: UFO 是 unidentified flying object 的首字母组合，“不明飞行物”，大写、小写都可以。

q17.explanationZh: ugly 形容词“难看的”，an ugly face“一张难看的脸”，前面用 an。

q18.explanationZh: ultimate“最终的”加 -ly 构成副词 ultimately“最终”。

q19.explanationZh: umbrella“伞”，元音音素开头，前面用 an：an umbrella。

q20.explanationZh: un- 表示否定，unable“不能的”，be unable to do sth.“不能做某事”。

q21.explanationZh: un- + believe + -able = unbelievable“难以置信的”，注意 believe 去 e。

q22.explanationZh: uncle 指叔叔、舅舅、伯伯等长辈男性亲属。

q23.explanationZh: un- + conscious“有意识的”= unconscious“失去知觉的”，注意 -scious 的拼写。

q24.explanationZh: under 介词“在……下面”，under no circumstances“无论如何都不”。

q25.explanationZh: under + go = undergo“经历；遭受”，过去式 underwent，过去分词 undergone。

q26.explanationZh: under + ground = underground“地下的；在地下”，the underground“地铁”。

q28.explanationZh: under + line = underline“在……下面划线；强调”。

q29.explanationZh: understand“理解；懂”，过去式和过去分词都是 understood。

q30.explanationZh: understanding 作形容词“通情达理的”，作名词“理解；谅解”。

q31.explanationZh: under + take = undertake“承担”，过去式 undertook，过去分词 undertaken。

q32.explanationZh: un- 表示“相反动作”，undo“解开；取消”，过去式 undid，过去分词 undone。

q33.explanationZh: under no circumstances“无论在什么条件下都不”，放在句首时句子要部分倒装。

q34.explanationZh: turn down“（把音量）调低；拒绝”，反义词组是 turn up“调高”。

q35.explanationZh: turn in“上交”，Turn in your homework.“交作业。”

q36.explanationZh: turn out“原来是；结果是；生产”，turn out to be“结果证明是”。

q37.explanationZh: turn over“移交；仔细考虑；翻阅”，turn over the key“交出钥匙”。

q38.explanationZh: turn A into B“把 A 变成 B”，也可表示“把 A 译成 B”。

q39.explanationZh: turn to sb. (for help)“向某人求助”，to 是介词。

q40.explanationZh: turn up“调高；出现”，与 turn down“调低”相对。

q41.explanationZh: turn 加 -ing 构成 turning，turning point“转折点；转机”。

q42.explanationZh: turn off“关掉（电器、水、煤气等）”，反义 turn on。

q43.explanationZh: turn on“打开（电器、水、煤气等）”，反义 turn off。

q44.explanationZh: “不能做某事”= (be) unable to do sth.，to 后接动词原形。

q45.explanationZh: unbelievable“难以置信的；惊人的”，expense“费用”。

q46.explanationZh: knock sb. unconscious“把某人打昏”，unconscious 是形容词作宾语补足语。

q47.explanationZh: undergo“经受；遭受”，suffering 是不可数名词，用 much 修饰。

q48.explanationZh: “轮到你背课文了”，It’s one’s turn to do sth.“轮到某人做某事”，turn 是名词。

q49.explanationZh: “管子常用来导流液体”，谓语是 are，主语用复数 Tubes。

q50.explanationZh: “她不会开动机器”，be unable to do sth.“不能做某事”。

q51.explanationZh: “解铃还须系铃人”，undo the knot“解开结”，不定式 to 后用原形 undo。

q52.explanationZh: “他答应周五前完成工作”，undertake to do sth.“承担做某事”，讲过去的事用过去式 undertook。

q53.explanationZh: “从远处他听到了打字机的咔嗒声”，type“打字”+ writer = typewriter“打字机”，a 后用单数。

q54.explanationZh: “我对这个词的理解和你的不同”，My 后需要名词，understanding of“对……的理解”。

q55.explanationZh: “祈使句 + and + 将来时”：“把手柄向右转，箱子就开了”，用动词原形 Twist。

q56.explanationZh: “地铁列车从早上5:30运行到午夜12点”，underground trains“地铁列车”，句首首字母大写。

q57.explanationZh: “伦敦天气多变，应随身带伞”，take an umbrella with you“随身带伞”。

q58.sampleAnswer: The youth was fortunate in having understanding parents.
references: The youth was fortunate in having understanding parents.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: “通情达理的”= understanding，作形容词修饰 parents；be fortunate in doing“很幸运……”。

q59.sampleAnswer: The promotion marked a turning point in her career.
references: The promotion marked a turning point in her career.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “转折点”= turning point；mark a turning point in“标志着……的转折点”。

q60.sampleAnswer: Scientists are working hard to turn all this science fiction into medical reality.
references: Scientists are working hard to turn all this science fiction into medical reality.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “使……成为……”= turn A into B；“科学幻想”= science fiction。

q61.sampleAnswer: You can turn to a psychologist for help when you feel depressed.
references: You can turn to a psychologist for help when you feel depressed.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “向某人寻求帮助”= turn to sb. for help；“感到抑郁”= feel depressed。

q62.sampleAnswer: This night market has undergone decades of trials and tribulations. It not only has the strength to maintain its original charm, but also the vitality to explore new paths, attracting a steady flow of young people.
references: This night market has undergone decades of trials and tribulations. It not only has the strength to maintain its original charm, but also the vitality to explore new paths, attracting a steady flow of young people.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “历经”= undergo，到现在为止的经历用现在完成时 has undergone；“既……也……”= not only ... but also ...。

q63.sampleAnswer: Read the passage and underline the topic of each paragraph.
references: Read the passage and underline the topic of each paragraph.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “划出”= underline，祈使句用动词原形；“段落大意”= the topic of each paragraph。

q64.sampleAnswer: When the students are making their choices, their tutor may well guide them.
references: When the students are making their choices, their tutor may well guide them.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “导师”= tutor；“很好地指导”= may well guide；“做选择”= make choices。

q65.sampleAnswer: We are very upset to hear that our applications have been turned down.
references: We are very upset to hear that our applications have been turned down.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “拒绝”= turn down，“申请被拒绝”用被动语态 have been turned down。

q66.sampleAnswer: Although it is typical of teenagers to talk back to parents, they respect their parents in their hearts.
references: Although it is typical of teenagers to talk back to parents, they respect their parents in their hearts.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: it is typical of sb. to do sth.“做某事是某人的典型特点”；“顶嘴”= talk back to；although 不与 but 连用。

q67.sampleAnswer: There are so many different types of tests that students seem to get used to them.
references: There are so many different types of tests that students seem to get used to them.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “各类考试”= different types of tests；so ... that ...“如此……以至于……”；“习以为常”= get used to。
